entries.f48cfa1f1b9b137d: Based on the new philosophy system (vision of the future) formulated in February 2025, the group formulated its medium-term management plan (2025–2027), which was announced in March 2025. Its basic policy is “establishing a growth foundation that anticipates future changes in the business environment, and improving labor productivity that supports that growth strategy,” and it aims to achieve sustainable growth by promoting fundamental business reform and investing the resources generated thereby into diversifying business areas and creating new value from a long-term perspective. In the Heavy Temporary Works Business, the company is pursuing improved profitability, enhanced construction capability in the Tokyo metropolitan area, nationwide expansion of the steel frame processing and bridge fields, and strengthened collaboration with FUCHI Pte. Ltd. in Singapore; in the Construction Machinery Business, it aims to expand its business areas through collaboration and joint work with Mizuho Leasing Co., Ltd.
